speaker_role: current admissions officers (Hamilton College: associate dean, executive director, assistant dean of admission)
commercial_incentive: None evident beyond recruiting for Hamilton.
key_insights: Officers say they emphasize the impact an experience had on you, not a life autobiography; one specific moment usually beats a broad sweep.
Ordinary topics can stand out when written with real personal detail; examples given include a walking commute, a hometown movie theater, and Sunday dinners.
They discourage AI use for the essay, want plain natural vocabulary instead of thesaurus words, and can tell when a piece was rushed or over-edited.
Adversity essays should stress what was learned and coping; they advise a positive spin and warn against spending most words on describing the event.
For political or identity topics, the topic is the writer's choice; focus on personal impact and how you want to act, not persuading the reader.
Supplements count as much as the main essay; a why-college answer that could swap in another school's name is too generic, and firsthand engagement (visit, interview, tour) helps.
Common topics they see often: hospital visits, a broken arm, a bad grade, sports wins, fifth birthdays; approach matters more than topic.
specific_numbers_or_facts: One officer says reading a full application, including the essay, takes about 7 to 8 minutes with paired reading (Hamilton practice).
Common App essay length referenced as roughly 500 to 650 words.
Officers report 24, 21, and 2 years of essay-reading experience; they state no AI is used in reviewing applications at Hamilton.
Sent to the wrong school, a supplement naming another college may be forwarded to that college's office (Hamilton anecdote).
notable_or_distinctive: Direct statements from several current officers of a selective liberal arts college, including candid Q&A on AI, politics, identity, and supplements.
reliability_notes: Advice reflects one institution's view and they stress the process is subjective; auto-captions are mostly clean but slide content is not visible.
